cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Do I bring my own towel when I visit now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I leave, shall I hang it back there or put it with the guest laundry?

mechanism: A copies a social arrangement without understanding what it implies, then probes practical details to learn how B defines the relationship.
confusable: D73 seeks presence; D78 asks indirectly about the relationship without naming a desired label.
comparison: Wedding accommodation and family seating versus whether a visiting former household member still has a place.
seedUse: Preserve the indirect practical questions and B careful boundaries.
